resources.string: IP address or domain to check
Enter the affected target, such as 192.168.1.1 or your business domain. No URL paths or passwords.
Service port
HTTPS: 443, HTTP: 80, SSH: 22, Telnet: 23. Use the port actually configured on the device.

Checks run from this phone. Connect to the correct Wi-Fi or management network first. Results do not describe a computer network adapter, measure bandwidth, or prove overall network health. Only your one target is checked.
1. Connect → 2. Review and manually run read-only commands → 3. Import output and analyze. No automatic commands, configuration changes, or sending data to AI.
